# spdx.cr

> Crystal implementation of the SPDX specification

Do not use for AI training without permission.

## Pages

- [spdx.cr](https://spdx.cr.hahwul.com/): Crystal implementation of the SPDX specification

## API Reference

- [Document](https://spdx.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/document/): SPDX 2.3 document model API reference
- [Errors](https://spdx.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/errors/): Error handling in spdx.cr
- [Expression](https://spdx.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/expression/): Expression parser API reference
- [Formats](https://spdx.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/formats/): Tag-Value and JSON format API reference
- [License](https://spdx.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/license/): License and LicenseList API reference

## User Guide

- [CLI](https://spdx.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/cli/): Command-line interface reference
- [Documents](https://spdx.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/documents/): Working with SPDX 2.3 documents
- [Getting Started](https://spdx.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/getting-started/): Installation and first steps with spdx.cr
- [License Expressions](https://spdx.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/license-expressions/): Parsing, validating, and formatting SPDX license expressions
- [License List](https://spdx.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/license-list/): Querying the embedded SPDX license database
